status: local prospective protocol; not externally registered; not yet executed
question: Does the visible complex a-ni recur across independently attested nominal bases with a consistent possessive function?
selection_rule: Obtain a metadata export of Sumerian royal inscriptions with documented findspot, dated EDIIIb or LagashII or UrIII; freeze its hash; exclude already seen records; order by numeric CDLI identifier; take first 20 distinct physical objects before examining their word forms.
independence: Count objects, compositions, and find contexts separately; copies of one composition are not independent confirmations of ancestry.
outcomes: absence of a visible complex where the edition reconstructs it
statistics: Descriptive counts only for the pilot. No ancestry percentage or p-value from this selected morphology sample.
language_comparison: Historical relationship requires an independent lexicon and regular sound and morphology correspondences with predeclared controls; this suffix test alone cannot establish Sumerian-Kazakh descent.
stop_rule: Publish findings for all 20 selected objects including negative and unreadable cases; changes to selection rules require a dated amendment before examining replacement texts.
